links.outcome: Run-to-run reproducibility of LLM-generated NONMEM models across repeated runs
links.effect: Run-to-run reproducibility was variable; PKGPT also missed clinically established covariates in all datasets.
links.quote: Across datasets, PKGPT did not identify clinically established covariates, and run-to-run reproducibility was variable.
